21 October 2022 | longest unbeaten = | longest wins = | prevseason = [[2021–22 National First Division|2021–22]] | nextseason = [[2023–24 National First Division|2023–24]] }} The '''2022–23 National First Division''' (called the Motsepe Foundation Championship for sponsorship reasons) was the season from September 2022 to June 2023 of South Africa's second tier of professional [[association football|soccer]], the [[National First Division]]. Previous sponsors GladAfrica pulled out after three years of their five-year deal, and were replaced by [[Patrice Motsepe]], with the competition being renamed the Motsepe Foundation Championship.{{Cite web |date=2022-07-01 |title=Motsepe Foundation Sponsor The PSL's National First Division |url=https://www.soccerladuma.co.za/news/articles/local/categories/south-africa/motsepe-foundation-sponsor-the-psl-s-national-first-division/719876 |access-date=2022-08-20 |website=Soccer Laduma}}{{Cite web |title=MOTSEPE FOUNDATION NEW NFD SPONSOR - The NFD |url=https://www.thenfd.co.za/motsepe-foundation-new-nfd-sponsor |access-date=2022-08-20 |website=www.thenfd.co.za}} ==Teams== ===Team changes=== The following teams changed division since the 2021–22 season.
